set.body: Repetition, point sampling, epochs, template fit/CV/decomposition, map/scanpath/fixation comparison lack MethodDescriptor, Diagnostics mapping + catalog codes, Stepwise cursor/fs2 route, RecipeFamily and archive role (RecipeFamily has only FixationStudy, EventRecording, TemporalStudy; fs2/src/main references none of them). Also expose every map method to template_similarity (StudyPlan ships only StudyMethod.cosine). Add a conformance test enumerating families and each contract. Absorbs pl-analysis.
set.title: CR4: every analysis family meets the UI definition of done
